summary: This document presents quantitative results from various experimental conditions tested during the training of a custom language model. The tables detail performance metrics across different seeds, learning rates, and layer depths, including correct classifications, transfer counts, and validation loss.
key_facts: Margin = p(correct) - p(best wrong choice), averaged over the 3 cases.
The experiments used seeds 42, 1, 2, and 3 in sequence.
Condition A achieved validation losses of 0.71 / 0.68 / 0.70 / 0.69.
Condition B achieved validation losses of 0.73 / 0.77 / 0.83 / 0.81.
Condition C achieved validation losses of 1.18 / 0.99 / 1.14 / 1.06.
B_lr0.01 condition achieved validation losses of 0.74 / 0.76 / 0.82 / 0.77.
B_steps10000 condition achieved validation losses of 0.80 / 0.90 / 0.92 / 0.88.
